## About
Mr Lucky's is one of the oldest pool rooms in Los Angeles, and we've got a generational following. We aspire to create a friendly place for all.
If you're looking for a place to hang out, cool down with a beer or a game of pool, this is the spot. Tables go by the hour, and when it's busy you just put your name on the list.
We're rated 4.5 from 384 Google reviews. Come see why.

## Services
- Brunswick Gold Crowns: The regulation table the pros play on, kept dead straight and felted with Simonis cloth.
- Diamond pro-am bar tables: Bar tables top rated by professionals.
- Weekly BCA sponsored leagues: Weekly league play on our tables. Ask at the front about joining.
- 24 tap draft system: Local and classic beers, kept cold and frosty. Think Smog City IPA, Stone IPA, Guinness, Modelo and El Segundo Broken Skull, plus bottled beers and some fruity alternatives.
- Snacks and non-alcoholic beverages: Something to munch on and something to sip if you're not drinking.

## FAQ
Q: When are you open?
A: We open at noon every day and stay open later on Friday and Saturday nights.

Q: Can I get food?
A: Yep. You can have food delivered, and Dominoes is right next door. Just no outside beverages.

Q: How do you charge for tables?
A: Tables are paid by the hour.

Q: What if all the tables are taken?
A: Put your name on the list and hang out with a beer until one opens up.

## What customers say
- "Love this place! Close to home, great date spot! They do have beer and ciders on tap, there are several tables, and if you don't mind waiting if it's busy you can just put your name on the list and hang out with your friend or date. We went for a date night, and even ordered food from Domino's and ate outside and went back in, only to see the others actually brought their food into the establishment. They played an eclectic playlist that I actually liked, it was loud enough to hear, but I also could easily hear my partner when we were talking. You pay for the table by the hour, and it was a really good experience for us! Parking was free, easy, and plenty." (Sabrina Keigley, 5/5)

The tables are spread apart well and has plenty of room to walk around the tables.

Good music playing.
